verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global HR/EOR SaaS platform that handles sensitive employee data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, data deletion endpoints, or user-controlled data lifecycle settings. The docs cover webhooks, sandboxes, employment creation and benefits, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
